# Trimble API endpoint coverage

Every operation in every API definition that Trimble publishes in its official SwaggerHub organisation (https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/Trimble-Connect) is listed here with exactly one disposition. The definitions were retrieved on 2026-09-29. `internal/catalog` tests fail if any operation lacks a disposition.

| Disposition | Meaning | MCP tool |
|---|---|---|
| `read` | Production read; executed against the documented regional host | `trimble_api_read`, or a typed tool where listed |
| `plan` | Production change (POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE); validated and returned as a dry-run request plan, never executed | `trimble_api_plan` |
| `variant` | The same method and path as a production operation in a staging, integration, QA, test or draft copy | Covered by the production operation named in `covered_by` |
| `excluded` | Not callable by the bridge; the reason is recorded per operation | none |

**Totals:** 1747 operations; 254 read, 223 plan, 919 variant, 351 excluded.
